title: Vertiv expands its global liquid cooling portfolio with the announcement of two new high-capacity coolant distribution units to support AI applications
summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions, today announced a significant expansion of its liquid cooling product portfolio with the introduction of two new Vertiv™ CoolChip CDU (coolant distribution unit) systems. These systems enable modular, cost-effective liquid cooling deployments in data centers, making it possible to operate high-density computing for AI alongside traditional air-cooled racks. The new CDUs are on display at the Vertiv booth at SC24, the international conference for high performance computing, networking and storage, from November 19 - 22.
